ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in the recent fraud schemes uncovered in Minnesota, including the $250M scheme and the $21 million Medicaid fraud scheme.
questions: How did the money flow through the schemes?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may uncover larger patterns of corruption and fraud in Minnesota, and potentially connect the schemes to other entities or individuals.
